camera_range_m.note: fixed network property, carried through for downstream use

visible_queue_length_m.note: furthest queued vehicle VISIBLE to the camera -- never the true total queue length

visible_occupancy_fraction.note: fraction of the camera's OWN 150m range the visible queue fills -- not fraction of true queue

queue_reaches_camera_edge.note: BOUNDARY/CENSORING indicator: True means the visible queue reaches ~the camera's edge, which does NOT mean the true queue equals camera_range_m.

visible_queue_length_m_change_30s.note: spans 30 real seconds on the shared SAMPLING_INTERVAL_S=5s grid

visible_mean_speed_mps_change_30s.note: spans 30 real seconds on the shared SAMPLING_INTERVAL_S=5s grid

probe_max_distance_to_stopline_m.note: a real probe sighting; may exceed camera_range_m by design -- GPS is not range-limited

is_green_for_approach.note: inherits the not-independently-verified phase-to-approach mapping caveat

estimated_density_k_veh_per_km.note: OBSERVED-REGION, MIXED-REGIME density (may include both free-flow and queued vehicles simultaneously) -- not true total-link density

observed_flow_veh_per_hour.note: an AGGREGATE, mixed-regime flow, NOT the clean upstream arrival flow LW section 6's shock formula would require -- kept as a general traffic-state feature only

estimated_queue_front_propagation_m_per_.note: rate of change of visible_queue_length_m over its VERIFIED elapsed window (see v0.5 note); positive = queue growing upstream. Valid ONLY while queue_reaches_camera_edge is False this interval; NA when censored

estimated_hidden_queue_extension_m.source: first-order held-rate extrapolation, inspired by LW (1955) eq (17)'s shock-position concept but not that exact solution
estimated_hidden_queue_extension_m.note: FIRST-ORDER approximation only -- extrapolates the last pre-censoring propagation rate forward across red_duration_s while censored. A MODEL ESTIMATE, never a substitute for the true label

_removed_features.visible_{vehicle_type}_frac: camera_simulator.py does not report vehicle-type composition.
_removed_features.entry_flow_veh_per_hour / discharge_flow: were per-vehicle boundary-crossing counts (LW eq 1, q=n/tau); not producible from the camera's snapshot output.
_removed_features.probe_critical_point_count / probe_shock: Cheng et al.'s method (read in full via its 2010 TRB precursor -- see module docstring) requires per-vehicle trajectory data keyed by probe id to detect a specific probe's critical point; gps_simulator.py exposes only AGGREGATE probe statistics, and this remains true even after the v0.5 5-second resolution (resolution and per-probe identity are independent properties). An earlier adaptation using the aggregate probe_max_distance_to_stopline_m field as a substitute for Cheng et al.'s L_CP2 was found, on reading their actual equations, to be a materially coarser and different quantity -- removed rather than kept as a mislabeled approximation.
_removed_features.estimated_shockwave_w_bf_m_per_s: REMOVED in v0.4: computed flux from the camera's whole visible region, which mixes free-flow and queued vehicles and is not the clean upstream state LW section 6's red-signal shock formula requires. Replaced by estimated_queue_front_propagation_m_per_s.

_unimplemented_paper_methods.Richards (1956): full text not accessible (paywalled); no equation used.
_unimplemented_paper_methods.Cheng et al. (2012): full method understood via its 2010 TRB precursor; not implementable with ASTRID's current AGGREGATE GPS sensor (unaffected by the v0.5 5-second resolution) -- requires per-probe trajectories keyed by probe id.
_unimplemented_paper_methods.Rempe, Kessler & Bogenberger (2017): full text not accessible (paywalled); no equation used.
_unimplemented_paper_methods.Kumari, Bhavya, Reddy, Gopi & Lalitha (2: full text/abstract not accessible; no concept used.

_labels_file_note: true_queue_length_m / true_queue_beyond_camera / true_queue_length_future_m live only in labels_{layer}.csv, never in features_{layer}.csv. The feature-building code path never opens ground_truth/ or raw_output/vehicle_trajectories.csv.
_k_jam_assumption: effective_gap_m=2.5 -- a project assumption, NOT confirmed against this scenario's actual vType/car-following configuration, and not sourced from any paper.
